exposure: Addition of azithromycin to standard preoperative antibiotic prophylaxis
cohort: N/A - This abstract is a commentary discussing evidence from previous studies concerning patients undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: Precesarean vaginal preparation significantly reduces postoperative endometritis rates (by more than 50%), similar to the addition of azithromycin, yet this practice is not uniformly adopted in the United States.
mod_finding: Precesarean vaginal preparation and azithromycin addition are effective strategies to reduce postoperative infections, specifically endometritis, following cesarean delivery.
